下部：苍穹无恙第644章取舍两难，道心再磨
第一节万局皆崩，中道绝路
上古虚空裂隙深处，灰白混沌翻涌不息，万古尘埃悬浮浮沉。
那一句来自初代天道的本源道音，寥寥四字，却如万钧重锤，狠狠砸在凌无妄的道心之上，震得他周身法则裂痕片片震颤，燃烧寿元带来的灼痛瞬间被极致的思辨寒意覆盖。
无衡之道，必崩。
短短一语，宣判了百万年天道迭代的终极宿命，也将他此刻正在铸就的新生平衡天道，推入了进退维谷的绝境。
此前勘破两代天道的两极谬误，凌无妄一度以为自己握住了大道正途。初代天道放任自流，自由泛滥以致界域倾覆；墨规天道极致禁锢，管控过甚以致苍生桎梏。一纵一收，一乱一僵，皆是极端残缺。
那只要取其中道，松紧相衡、自由有度、秩序有温，便可终结万古轮回，铸就真正无恙苍穹。
这是他堕凡三载、立道百日，一路破局纠错、涤荡黑暗得出的答案，也是新天道雏形得以落地的核心根基。
可此刻身处万古裂隙，直面天道本源的终极推演，他才骤然发现，自己引以为傲的平衡之道，竟是一条没有落地可能的绝路。
混沌本源剧烈翻涌，万千天道模拟图景凭空浮现，密密麻麻铺满整片虚空。
无数种规则配比、无数种秩序尺度、无数种自由与约束的搭配方案，以肉眼难辨的极速推演、成型、运转、崩塌。
第一种推演，适度放宽底线，保留众生大部分自主择道、自由修行的权利，仅增设基础善恶制衡、杀伐禁令、资源分配规则，弥补初代天道的留白漏洞。
这套秩序初成之时，三界欣欣向荣，万道蓬勃共生，彻底摆脱了墨规子三万载的压抑死寂。寒门修士得以突破阶级桎梏，无名道统得以传承延续，天地灵气自由流转，苍生拥有了前所未有的生机与希望。
可仅仅万载光阴，隐患便悄然滋生。
人心贪欲无界，修行执念难平。没有极致的规则约束，部分强者再度滋生霸权之心，以修为碾压弱小，以势力掠夺资源。底线禁令虽在，可因果制衡的尺度终究留有缝隙，钻空子者层出不穷，徇私舞弊者逐年增多。
百年积弊，千年成患，万年成灾。
最初温和自由的平衡秩序，一步步松动、畸变、失控，最终重蹈上古覆辙，界域战火重燃，纷争席卷八荒，新生天道轰然崩塌。
图景破碎，化为点点混沌流光消散。
第二种推演，适度收紧底线，强化天道监管力度，细化功过评判体系，压缩众生越界作乱的空间，杜绝强权滋生、乱象蔓延。

这套秩序落地后，三界安稳太平，无纷争、无掠夺、无战乱，完美规避了上古自由泛滥的祸端。天地规则严谨规整，因果循环清晰分明，众生恪守底线，修行井然有序。
可安稳的代价，是生机的彻底凋零。
过度的监管、细化的约束、严苛的评判，一点点压缩众生的创造空间。修士不敢突破常规悟道，凡人不敢随心立业求生，万物循规蹈矩、一成不变，大道失去迭代演化的可能。
久而久之，修行沦为刻板流程，悟道变成机械积累，三界彻底失去蓬勃生机，陷入一潭死水的僵化格局。
看似永恒安稳的天道秩序，实则慢慢枯竭、枯萎，最终大道停滞、灵气衰败，整片世界在死寂中缓缓崩塌。
又是一局，全盘皆崩。
第三种、第四种、第五种……
万千种推演方案接连更迭，或偏宽、或偏严、或居中微调尺度、或增减制衡条款、或优化因果逻辑、或迭代监管体系。
凌无妄凝神静气，调动残存的本源道心，穷尽自己执掌天道百万载的规则积累，一次次修正参数、重构逻辑、打磨尺度。
他试图寻找那一条绝对完美、永恒稳固的平衡中线，试图打破无衡必崩的万古宿命。
可结局从未有过半分例外。
松一分则乱，紧一分则僵。
宽衡生乱，严衡生枯。
但凡存在规则尺度，但凡留有调整空间，但凡由天道体系自主运转，最终逃不出崩塌的结局。
虚空之中，万千破灭的天道图景层层碎裂，无数覆灭的光影交织成一片绝望的灰白帷幕，彻底笼罩凌无妄周身。
他伫立混沌中央，黑发猎猎舞动，周身细密的法则裂痕不断渗出道道微光，燃烧寿元的虚弱感席卷全身。
原本通透圆满的道心，第一次滋生出极致的迷茫与困顿。
他推翻了墨规子的极端禁锢，终结了三万年的黑暗秩序，勘破了初代天道的放任弊端，铸就了动态平衡的新生天道。

Part 2: The Sky is Safe Chapter 644 Dilemma of choice, the Taoist heart is tempered again
In the first quarter, everything falls apart, and there is no way out in the middle.
Deep in the cracks of the ancient void, gray-white chaos surges endlessly, and eternal dust floats.
The original Taoist sound from the first generation of Heavenly Dao was just four words, but it was like a heavy hammer, hitting Ling Wuwu's Taoist heart hard, causing cracks in the laws all over his body to tremble, and the burning pain caused by burning longevity was instantly covered by the extreme chill of speculation.
Without balance, everything will collapse.
In just one sentence, he pronounced the ultimate fate of millions of years of iterations of the Heavenly Dao, and also pushed the new balanced Heavenly Dao he was currently building into a dilemma.
Having previously uncovered the bipolar fallacy of two generations of heavenly ways, Ling Wuwang once thought that he had grasped the right path. In the first generation, the way of heaven was left to its own devices, and freedom overflowed to the point of overturning the realm; while the way of heaven was extremely restrictive and over-controlled, causing the people to be shackled. One vertical and one closed, one chaotic and one stiff, all are extremely incomplete.
As long as we find the right path, balance tightness, freedom, and order, we can end the eternal cycle of reincarnation and create a truly safe sky.
This is the answer he came up with after three years of being in the mortal world and a hundred days of establishing the Way. He corrected mistakes and purged the darkness along the way. It is also the core foundation for the prototype of the new way of heaven to be implemented.
But now he was in the eternal rift, facing the ultimate deduction of the origin of the way of heaven, and he suddenly discovered that the way of balance that he was proud of was actually a dead end with no possibility of landing.
The source of chaos surged violently, and thousands of simulated images of heaven emerged out of thin air, densely covering the entire void.
Countless rule ratios, countless order scales, and countless combinations of freedom and constraints are deduced, formed, operated, and collapsed at a speed that is difficult to discern with the naked eye.
The first kind of deduction moderately relaxes the bottom line, retains the rights of most sentient beings to choose their own paths and practice freely, and only adds basic checks and balances of good and evil, killing bans, and resource allocation rules to fill in the gaps left by the first generation of heaven.
When this order was first established, the three realms were prosperous, and all the ways flourished and coexisted, completely getting rid of the 30,000-year-old oppressive silence of Mo Guizi. The poor monks were able to break through the shackles of class, the nameless Taoism was passed on and continued, the spiritual energy of heaven and earth circulated freely, and the common people had unprecedented vitality and hope.
But in just ten thousand years, hidden dangers have quietly arisen.
The human heart is greedy and has no boundaries, and it is difficult to calm down the obsession with spiritual practice. Without the ultimate restraint of rules, some strong people once again have a desire for hegemony, using their cultivation to crush the weak and using their power to plunder resources. Although the bottom line prohibition exists, there are still gaps in the scale of checks and balances, and there are endless loopholes to take advantage of, and the number of people practicing favoritism and malpractice is increasing year by year.
A hundred years of accumulated evil will lead to troubles in a thousand years and disasters in ten thousand years.
The initially gentle and free balanced order gradually became loosened, distorted, and out of control, and eventually it repeated the mistakes of ancient times. The war in the realm rekindled, disputes swept across the wasteland, and the new way of heaven suddenly collapsed.
The picture shattered and turned into little chaotic streams of light that dissipated.
The second kind of deduction is to appropriately tighten the bottom line, strengthen the supervision of heaven, refine the merits and demerits evaluation system, reduce the space for sentient beings to cross the line and cause chaos, and prevent the growth of power and the spread of chaos.
After this set of order was implemented, the three realms were stable and peaceful, with no disputes, no plundering, and no wars, which perfectly avoided the evil of the proliferation of freedom in ancient times. The rules of heaven and earth are strict and regular, the cycle of cause and effect is clear, all living beings abide by the bottom line, and practice in an orderly manner.
But the price of stability is the complete loss of vitality.
Excessive supervision, detailed restrictions, and harsh judgments gradually shrink the creative space of all living beings. Monks do not dare to break through the routine to realize the Tao, and mortals do not dare to establish a career to survive as they please. All things follow the rules and remain unchanged, and the Tao loses the possibility of iterative evolution.
Over time, practice has become a rigid process, enlightenment has become a mechanical accumulation, and the three realms have completely lost their vitality and fallen into a rigid pattern of stagnant water.
The seemingly eternal and stable order of heaven is actually slowly drying up and withering. Eventually, the avenue stagnates, the spiritual energy declines, and the entire world slowly collapses in deathly silence.Another game, everything fell apart.
The third, fourth, fifth...
Thousands of deduction plans are constantly changing, some are too wide, some are too strict, some are fine-tuned, some are added or removed, some are added or removed, some are optimized for causal logic, or some are iterated on the regulatory system.
Ling Wuwan calmed down, mobilized the remaining original Taoist heart, exhausted the millions of years of accumulation of rules he had controlled the way of heaven, revised parameters, reconstructed logic, and polished the standards again and again.
He tried to find that absolutely perfect, eternally stable center line of balance, trying to break the eternal fate of collapse without balance.
But the ending is never the slightest exception.
If it is too loose, it will be chaotic; if it is too tight, it will be stiff.
Kuan Heng brings chaos, strict Heng brings dryness.
As long as there are rules and standards, as long as there is room for adjustment, and as long as the Heavenly Dao system operates independently, there will be no way to escape the end of collapse.
In the void, thousands of shattered images of heaven were shattered layer by layer, and countless destroyed lights and shadows intertwined into a despairing gray curtain, completely covering Ling Wuwang's body.
He stood in the center of the chaos, his black hair fluttering. The fine cracks in the laws around him were constantly seeping out glimmers of light, and a sense of weakness that burned life span swept through his body.
The Taoist heart that was originally transparent and perfect became extremely confused and trapped for the first time.
He overthrew the extreme confinement of Mo Guizi, ended the 30,000-year dark order, uncovered the laissez-faire shortcomings of the first generation of Heaven, and created a new dynamically balanced Heaven.
